title: fix(auth): the sign-in page reads the sign-in methods the server has now after sign-out

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：管理员在设置页关掉邮箱密码登录、登出后，登录页不再画邮箱密码表单，改为显示服务端现在真正开着的登录方式（如 Google）。
- 为什么改：前端把登录配置缓存到页面刷新为止；设置可以热改后，同一标签页登出看到的是旧配置，表单点了也会被服务端拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `@object-ui/auth` 的配置缓存：登出或读不到会话时丢弃缓存，登录状态内行为不变；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 的 `forgetConfig` 两个调用点（`signOut` 开头、`getSession` 返回空之前）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/createAuthClient.test.ts`，预期 36 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；「关闭前确认」需要 settings-manifest 新键，席位另开卡。

## What changes

`createAuthClient().getConfig()` single-flights and caches `/auth/config`. The cache's comment said the config is static per server boot, and it lived for the page's whole life. It is no longer static: the Authentication settings page turns email and password and the Google provider on and off while the server runs, and `/auth/config` answers the new set at once. An administrator who turned email and password off (with Google configured) and signed out inside the console was shown the email and password form from the copy read while signed in, and no Google button.

The cache now lives for one signed-in stretch. A new closure helper, `forgetConfig()`, drops it:

- at the start of `signOut()` (before the request, so a failed sign-out, which still clears the token, forgets it too);
- when `getSession()` finds no session (an expired session reaches the sign-in page without a sign-out).

Readers on one page still share one request, and nothing changes while a session lasts. Both login hosts read the config through this client, so the console's own sign-in page is covered without touching it.

What this card's two Wanted items get here:

- Item 1, first half (the server's refusal text): already holds on `main`, measured below. The floor's refusal arrives as `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` with one `details.fields` entry carrying the localized message; the settings page draws it under the "Enable email/password login" row and toasts "1 setting needs attention: Enable email/password login". No change needed.
- Item 1, second half (confirm before turning email and password off): NOT in this PR, by the seat's ruling. The settings page is a generic manifest renderer and a toggle specifier has no confirm key; the honest home is a new settings-manifest key, which is spec work, so it goes to its own card. Hard-coding `auth.email_password_enabled` in the renderer was ruled out.
- Item 2 (login page draws the form when `emailPassword.enabled` is false): the cause was the stale client cache above, not the dev sign-in chip. `LoginForm` already collapses the form on `enabled === false`; it was handed the old answer.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/createAuthClient.test.ts`, new top-level describe in the existing harness: the cached config is kept while the session lasts (one request), and read again after `signOut()`; and read again after `getSession()` answers no session.
- Reverse verification: with the base `createAuthClient.ts` restored over the committed test, both new cases go red (2 failed, 34 passed); restored by `git checkout HEAD`, hash matched HEAD's blob.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured live on an own stack: `examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4317` plus the console dev server on 5317, Playwright driving the real pages. Scenario: sign in, Setup, Settings, Authentication; turn email and password off and save (refused, row message shown); add Google client ID and secret in the same draft and save (accepted, `/auth/config` then reports `emailPassword.enabled: false` and a Google provider); sign out from the account menu.
  - Before (base client): sign-in page draws Email and Password and the Sign In button, no Google button; no `/auth/config` request after sign-out.
  - After (this branch): one `/auth/config` request after sign-out answering `enabled: false`; the page draws "Continue with Google" and no email field.
- Out of scope, for the seat to file: the dev "Sign in as dev admin" chip on the console sign-in page is still offered when email and password are off, and it signs in with email and password, which the server refuses. It lives in the console sign-in page, held by another card.
- Out of scope, for the seat to file: the settings spec declares `confirmText` on `action_button` handlers, and the console settings field never reads it, so an action declared with a confirmation runs without one.
